body: Get, JSON and Decode never expand. Expanded() returns a new Doc with string values expanded and transformed (keys never); GetExpanded(path) the same for one value. WithExpand() only makes the one-call Read expand. ${NAME} resolves only through Lookupers (WithLookup, plugins); unknown names are empty like Compose; ${scheme:ref} through Resolvers; $(cmd) only with WithCommandSubstitution or a CommandRunner plugin. Alternative rejected: an option that makes Get return expanded values, because then the same Doc reads differently depending on construction and a later Save could not be trusted to keep references.
title: jsonc reads raw; expansion only through Expanded/GetExpanded
